perks.name: Ballistic Tuning
perks.desc:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Supercooled Accelerator
perks.desc:
Optimized for extended range.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Tempered Truss Rod
perks.desc:
High stiffness for quick handling.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases range

perks.name: Low-Impedance Windings
perks.desc:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

perks.name: Auxiliary Reserves
perks.desc:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Lightweight Emitter
perks.desc:
Weight reduction for better agility.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Swap Mag
perks.desc: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.desc: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Tilting at Windmills
perks.desc: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed while shielding.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.desc: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.desc: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.desc: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Melee Momentum
perks.desc: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.desc: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Beacon Rounds
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed. Dealing further damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Heretical Behavior
perks.desc: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants. Gain this bonus immediately for a longer duration when you are revived.

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.desc: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.desc: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "So this glaive may actually change my mind on glaives. Nearly all of the third column is good for PvE. You can Slice, get better projectile speed, extra ammo in the mag, auto-loading, shield shenanigans, or ammo from thin air. Combine any of these with the damage from Sword Logic or Vorpal Weapon, the shield breaking and damage stacking with Disruption Break. There's so many good combinations you may just have to try them all out." Recommended MW: Shield Duration.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While there's so many interesting combinations in PvP there's the set standard of Tilting at Windmills and Unstoppable Force in PvP. It's not Immovable Object but it will suffice. Impulse Amplifier will still be best in slot for offering near instant projectiles. Slice for Sever is also great in any team environment. The funniest build for me is the full block fast movement (fast as ~~f*ck~~ boi) with Tilting at Windmills and the new Melee Momentum perk providing a total of 14 seconds of improved movement speed (it's also possible it stacks for 4 seconds of super fast speed)." Recommended MW: Range or Shield Duration.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 135 from 25 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5JwIN3avdyW27aRjv4Zb2D?si=21b247e788174887) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor adds in both general at-level or better, or end-game underleveled content, particularly with melee builds. Refusal of the Call is the first adaptive frame strand glaive, which is the subfamily with the best shield duration, if that's your play. At base, the stats are okay - 64 Range equates to 18.49m and a velocity of 111.28m/s, 44 Shield Duration is 11.49s, 60 Handling is 0.30s ready and 0.35s stow speed, 43 Reload Speed is a 2.75s reload, and magazine size is 6 (max 8). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 30/36/40/42 (max 42). There are a couple of Haft perks that can help boost shield duration, but they have a mix of bonuses and maluses, so go with that suits your playstyle best. For the magazine perk, either look for something that helps with mag size or reload. The most thought-free, reliable trait perk combination for glaives is Replenishing Aegis, which partially refills the mag when blocking damage with the shield, together with Close to Melee to boost the glaive melee damage by ×1.3 for 10s on a projectile hit (refreshable for 5s on melee or projectile hits), or Disruption Break which provides a ×1.5 boost to glaive melee damage for 5.5s if you break an enemy's shield with a projectile. Willing Vessel is a useful, if unspectacular origin trait to boost gunfeel stats in the background as you hit and kill targets, but if you're in a fireteam, and manually reloading, Runneth Over will overfill your magazine by an additional 10% (rounded up) for each Guardian you're within 15m of. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Strand Tangles or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.
